segments.name: 01-intro
text: 11 optional mutators for native Sonic 1, Sonic 2 and Sonic 3 & Knuckles
Example creator mod  ·  every effect off by default  ·  your own ROMs

segments.name: 02-hub-s1
segments.caption: Mutator Lab opens from each game's own title screen.

segments.name: 03-hub-s2
segments.caption: Start, configure, or read how to play.

segments.name: 04-hub-s3k
segments.caption: Native ROM play; the menu cues are the games' own sound effects.

segments.name: 05-gravity
segments.caption: 25–200% dry fall acceleration for ordinary Sonic. Jumps, water, hurt and scripted motion stay native.

segments.name: 06-ringfall
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: When hurt you still lose every held ring; only 10–100% scatter back as recoverable rings, with an optional 1–32 cap.

segments.name: 07-bighead
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: 100–200% about the neck on reviewed native Sonic head pixels. Feet, body and collisions unchanged.

segments.name: 08-stealth
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: Hides the player sprite. Gameplay, HUD, sound and world effects stay native.

segments.name: 09-nopowerups
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: Per-type monitor filters, applied on the next full LOAD. Types a game lacks show Unavailable.

segments.name: 10-nocheckpoints
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: Death returns to the act start. Death banking is independent of stage-entry triggers.

segments.name: 11-norings
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: Removes main-level rings and ring rewards on a full load. Main play only.

segments.name: 12-gamespeed
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: 25–400% in whole native steps, with optional audio follow. (Not visible in this video: the capture tool runs one tick per frame.)

segments.name: 13-nospecial
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: Denies new special-stage entry. A transition already admitted finishes normally.

segments.name: 14-nobonus
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: Sonic 3 & Knuckles only. Sonic 1 and 2 show it Unavailable.

segments.name: 15-violent
segments.kind: held native UI frame (audio continues from same capture)
segments.caption: 150–300% vertical badnik-defeat rebound with a speed cap. Not radial blasts; bosses unaffected.

segments.name: 16-s1-bighead
segments.caption: Big Head at a fixed 150%, the default mode. The enlarged head is Sonic's own reviewed head pixels; the body underneath is untouched.

segments.name: 17-s1-live
segments.caption: Start holds play. Edits stay pending until Resume: Stealth on, Game Speed 200%. No Powerups waits for a restart or death.

segments.name: 18-s1-stealth
segments.caption: Stealth: Sonic is hidden. Camera, HUD, rings and sound carry on natively.

segments.name: 19-s1-load
segments.caption: Restart rebuilds the act through native assembly, so LOAD-time monitor filters take effect.

segments.name: 20-s2-bighead
segments.caption: Same mutators, same hub, Sonic 2's own engine rules and art.

segments.name: 21-s2-stealth
segments.caption: After Resume the player sprite is hidden; the world keeps running.

segments.name: 22-s3k-ball
segments.caption: Big Head on standing art. Curled, unreviewed, powered or non-Sonic art keeps the stock sprite.

segments.name: 23-s3k-stealth
segments.caption: Stealth targets the leader: Sonic vanishes while Tails, the sidekick, stays visible.

segments.name: 27-rh-earned
segments.header: NEW  ·  Big Head scales with rings
segments.caption: Collected in play, 0 to 11 rings. The LIVE menu reports the head at 111% for 11 rings (max 200%).

segments.name: 28-outro
text: Defaults off  ·  LIVE edits on Resume  ·  LOAD edits on native restart
Example mod jar prepared at JVM boot  ·  all game assets from your own ROMs
